title: UI layout and Slate widget rendering overhead
fix_rationale: Excessive Slate Prepass, un-invalidated dynamic widget trees, or slow Slate widget painting spike frame time.
evidence_template: {timer} consumed {ms} ms ({share}% of excess time) processing Slate widget layouts or UI drawing.

fixes.text: Wrap complex or static UMG widget hierarchies in RetainerBoxes or InvalidationBoxes to avoid full-tree Prepass and Paint every frame.
Avoid binding Blueprint functions directly to UMG widget property bindings (e.g. Text or Visibility); update properties via event dispatchers instead.
Reduce the number of active transparent/overlapping Slate widgets and collapse Visibility of hidden widgets instead of setting opacity to 0.

verify: Profile in Unreal Insights and verify that Slate::Prepass and Slate_PaintSlowPath times drop below 2 ms.
